---
title: "kutitles"
---

## Description

Assign titles according to TFL_titles.csv file.

## Parameters

**`progname`**

: Name of the SAS program, which is used for search in TFL_titles.csv

  *Required:* Yes

**`filepath`**

: Full path to TFL_titles.csv

  *Required:* No

**`seq`**

: Sequence number of the output in TFL_titles.csv file

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `1`

**`justify`**

: Option that determines the alignment of titles

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `c`

**`escapechar`**

: Escape character

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `$`

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%kutitles(s_000_ae3,seq=1);
%kutitles(l_000_dm,seq=1);
```
